text: The CRDAO price discovery mechanism enables full price transparency for consumers through the visibility of internal and external bids on job posts, which is unprecedented in a market otherwise dominated by a cartel.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709

isBasedOn.name: How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards

abstract: price discovery mechanism serves a key public service function in that it enables full price transparency for consumers based on the visibility of the internal and external bids on job posts. This price transparency is unique and unprecedented in a market that is otherwise dominated by a cartel.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: bids on the post and the winner become public after the customer selects
